# PDF fixtures

Real open-access papers, all published by PLOS under **CC BY 4.0**. Each file is the
publisher's print-ready PDF truncated to its first three pages so the repository stays small;
the pages themselves are unmodified. Attribution below satisfies the licence.

| File | Article | DOI |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trial_ziprasidone.pdf` | A 6 Week Randomized Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled Trial of Ziprasidone for the Acute Depressive Mixed State (PLOS ONE, 2012) | 10.1371/journal.pone.0034757 |
| `trial_mipomersen.pdf` | Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Trial of Mipomersen in Patients with Severe Hypercholesterolemia (PLOS ONE, 2012) | 10.1371/journal.pone.0049006 |
| `trial_linaclotide.pdf` | Linaclotide in Chronic Idiopathic Constipation Patients with Moderate to Severe Abdominal Bloating (PLOS ONE, 2015) | 10.1371/journal.pone.0134349 |
| `trial_silymarin.pdf` | Silymarin in non-cirrhotics with non-alcoholic steatohepatitis: A randomized, double-blind, placebo controlled trial (PLOS ONE, 2019) | 10.1371/journal.pone.0221683 |

`scanned_no_text_layer.pdf` is page 1 of the ziprasidone paper rendered to a grayscale raster
image and re-wrapped as a PDF. It carries no text layer and stands in for a scanned document.

PDFs were retrieved from `https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article/file?id=<doi>&type=printable`.
